newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 8.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Seven dead, 48 injured in resin factory fire.
Protesters plant flags on disputed island.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Six protesters land on disputed island.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance Ministry pushes streamlined business tax proposal.
Tax exemption on pensions to be clarified.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Initial public offering of President Mart shares delayed.
September trade surplus highest in nine years.
